test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by conclusions numbered I, II. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All journals are books.

Some books are fans.

All fans are wood.

**Conclusion (I): **Some journals are wood.

**Conclusion (II):** Some fans are books.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88f46a61f91c059cf0ec5fb1bff50646f9dee98d2e613ff43f20b12fcd7750fc.png] 

Conclusion (I): Some journals are wood →** False** (Because no definite relation given between journal and wood, so it can be possible only).

Conclusion (II): Some fans are books → **True** (Some books are fans implies that some fans are definitely books).

So, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Option 4"**.
